text: A retail investor's experience investing in traditional mutual funds is likely to be a poor indicator of whether that investor will understand the risks of investing in an unconstrained mutual fund.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2811729

isBasedOn.name: Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection

abstract: Accordingly, retail investors' experience investing in "traditional" mutual funds is likely to be a poor indicator of whether a retail investor will understand the risks associated with investing in a UMF.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: retail investors extrapolating from prior traditional mutual fund experience
